origin.mms_origins.floran.name: Floran
origin.mms_origins.floran.description: Plant-folk sustained by sunlight and shielded by bark-like skin. They take extra damage from fire and cannot eat meat.
origin.mms_origins.inchling.name: Inchling
origin.mms_origins.inchling.description: Tiny and light-footed, the Inchling can climb walls and tread without triggering mobs. Their small frame takes extra damage from every source.
origin.mms_origins.truffle.name: Truffle
origin.mms_origins.truffle.description: Fungal beings immune to poison. They switch their spores between a speed boost and a caustic attack, but never both at once.
origin.mms_origins.piglin.name: Piglin
origin.mms_origins.piglin.description: Nether natives resistant to fire, with gold armor lending them extra toughness. Open daylight tires them out.
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.description: Your hide is woody and thick, worth a measure of armor on its own.
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.descrip: Under open sky you tire far more slowly.
power.mms_origins.kindling.name: Kindling
power.mms_origins.kindling.description: You are dry as tinder. Fire hurts you half again as much.
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.name: Verdant Diet
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.descripti: You cannot bring yourself to eat meat.
power.mms_origins.diminutive.name: Diminutive
power.mms_origins.diminutive.description: You are very small, and cannot reach as far as others.
power.mms_origins.light_step.name: Light Step
power.mms_origins.light_step.description: You are far too light to set off anything that listens for footsteps.
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.descript: Everything hurts you half again as much.
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.descript: Toggle to cling to and climb sheer walls.
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.name: Spore Shift
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.descriptio: Toggle between drifting spores and acrid spores.
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.name: Acrid Spores
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.descript: While active, your attacks carry a caustic bite.
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.name: Drifting Spores
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.descripti: While acrid spores are down, you move noticeably faster.
power.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.de: Poison means nothing to a fungus.
power.mms_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.mms_origins.nether_born.descriptio: You wake in the Nether, and it is where you belong.
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.name: Fire Resilience
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.descri: Flame does half what it would to anyone else.
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.name: Sun Shy
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.description: Open daylight wears on you, and you tire faster under it.
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.name: Gilded Bearing
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.descrip: Gold sits well on you, lending real toughness.
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.name: Language Barrier
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.descr: Villagers cannot make sense of you, and price their goods accordingly. Every trade costs you more.
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.name: Cold Blooded
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.descripti: Heat finds you badly, hurting half again as much. Cold cannot touch you at all.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.name: Seaborn
power.mms_origins.seaborn.description: You wake in open ocean. Out of the water you can neither rest nor claim a place to wake.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.cant_sleep: You cannot rest out of the water.
power.mms_origins.water_power.name: Water Power
power.mms_origins.water_power.descriptio: Wet — submerged or under rain — your blows land far harder. Somewhere hot, or in the Nether, the same tide runs against you.
